newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends lower on hedge sales, trade active.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends lower on hedge sales, trade active.

text.p: WCE canola futures closed lower as the market struggled to absorb heavy hedge selling as recent gains sparked farmer selling in the cash market.
Floor sources noted volume was reasonably heavy with scale down commercial and local buying interest helping to limit losses along with the comparative strength of CBOT soybeans.
Hedge selling also weighed on the flaxseed market.
"There were light hedges today and that was enough to put the (flaxseed) market down," one WCE oilseed trader said.
Western barley was mixed with the main feature rolling forward of positions out of February into March or May. Commercials were featured liquidating February longs.
Feed wheat also closed mixed with March weakened by commercial selling and sentiment that feed supplies in western Canada are currently plentiful.
Activity was thin in oats and feed peas.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
